invariants.contract: The online journey runs play -> GET /api/session/:id -> sync -> close: the play response creates the session GET returns unchanged, every sync moves currentTime and adds timeListening while startTime stays at the position the play response reported, a repeated sync accumulates, a new play on the same device resumes at the synced position and closes the previous session, and the close stores the session and moves the caller progress.

invariants.contract: An offline client batch replayed after a lost connection keeps one stored session and one result id per id (a play_local_ id maps to one generated server id), and a later batch appends its new sessions; a failed upload leaves progress and stored sessions unchanged and the next batch still applies its valid entries.
